summary: Avoid repeated historical Pass aggregation and repair weekly readiness checks
details: Historical Pass set queries drive SQLite joins from the latest-event aggregate, retaining event ID selection, height bounds, owner/state filters and pagination without a schema migration.
The regtest script-registry oracle checks layered status/source results, and historical-context validation waits for the newly mined tip.
Bounded world-sim convergence waits retry SNAPSHOT_NOT_READY during rollback while keeping other errors and consensus checks strict.
Weekly keeps 2500 continuous rounds per seed and separates service compilation from the 300-minute simulation budget.
